newsitem.title: USA: Daniel names Lassiter CEO, Newton president.
newsitem.headline: Daniel names Lassiter CEO, Newton president.

text.p: Daniel Industries Inc said Friday it had named its chairman, Ronald Lassiter, to the additional post of chief executive.
The company also said it had named Thomas Alex Newton president and chief operating officer. Both appointments are effective July 1.
Lassiter has been serving as acting president and chief executive since the resignation of William Griffin in January 1997.
Lassiter will leave his post at Zapata Protein Inc where he has been chairman and chief executive since 1992. Zapata Protein is a subsidiary of Zapata Corp.
Newton was previously president of Reed Tool Co, a unit of Camco International Inc.
